hints.title: Frequency Metric Sorting
hints.text: The relative position of each character in the result is determined strictly by its occurrence frequency in descending order.

hints.title: Multiplicity Run Expansion
hints.text: Gather counts for all distinct characters, sort descending by frequency, and emit each character repeated by its count.

hints.title: Frequency Assembly String Construction
hints.text: Count frequencies across the string. Sort the distinct characters by count descending. Iterate through the sorted entries and concatenate character multiplied by count into the output string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) effective time since K is bounded by character set size.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the full string with custom pairwise comparator takes O(N log N) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting character frequencies takes O(N) and sorting at most 128 unique frequencies takes negligible constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should understand both bucket sort (O(N)) and priority/sort based frequency aggregation.
